# Runtime Environment Variables

This reference is generated from [`vllm_sail/envs.py`](../../vllm_sail/envs.py).
For workflow guidance, backend interaction rules and model-specific constraints,
see [Configuration](configuration.md). For build-time settings, see
[HGGC kernels](../developer_guide/kernels.md#build-settings).

## Resolution rules

- Every `VLLM_SAIL_*` variable accepts the corresponding `VLLM_PPU_*` alias for
  compatibility. The canonical `VLLM_SAIL_*` name always takes precedence when
  set, including `0` or an empty string.
- Shared or upstream names without `VLLM_SAIL_*` prefixes keep their own names
  and have no `VLLM_PPU_*` aliases.
- Boolean truthy values are `true`, `1`, `yes` and `on` (case-insensitive);
  an empty boolean is false, and an empty choice or integer uses its default.
- Regenerate or verify this file:

```bash
python tools/render_env_docs.py
python tools/render_env_docs.py --check
```

## Backend selection

| Variable | Default | Values | Aliases | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `VLLM_SAIL_MOE_BACKEND` | Unset (automatic) | `deepgemm`, `acext`, `triton` | `VLLM_PPU_MOE_BACKEND` | Select the PPU MoE group-GEMM backend instead of automatic selection. |
| `VLLM_SAIL_DENSE_BACKEND` | Unset (automatic) | `deepgemm`, `acext`, `triton` | `VLLM_PPU_DENSE_BACKEND` | Select the PPU dense-GEMM backend for quantized linear layers. |
| `VLLM_SAIL_DENSE_BF16_DEEPGEMM` | `0` | `0`, `1` | `VLLM_PPU_DENSE_BF16_DEEPGEMM` | Opt into the Zhenwu M890 BF16 dense DeepGEMM path. |
| `VLLM_SAIL_DEEPGEMM_MOE_TP_FUSED` | `0` | `0`, `1` | `VLLM_PPU_DEEPGEMM_MOE_TP_FUSED` | Enable the supported fused tensor-parallel DeepGEMM MoE path. |
| `VLLM_SAIL_DEEPGEMM_MOE_FUSED_ACT_QUANT` | `0` | `0`, `1` | `VLLM_PPU_DEEPGEMM_MOE_FUSED_ACT_QUANT` | Fuse activation and the second MoE GEMM's input quantization into DeepGEMM's SiLU/SiTU kernel for FP8 and MXFP4 experts; BF16 experts, unquantized dense MLPs and shared experts use its values-only epilogue. |
| `VLLM_SAIL_USE_PLA` | `1` | `0`, `1` | `VLLM_PPU_USE_PLA` | Allow PLA linear-attention paths where available. |
| `VLLM_SAIL_USE_DEEPSELECT` | `1` | `0`, `1` | `VLLM_PPU_USE_DEEPSELECT` | Allow the SAIL DeepSelect top-k backend for sparse indexers on Zhenwu M890. |
| `VLLM_GDN_DECODE_KERNEL` | `auto` | `auto`, `cuda`, `pla`, `triton` | — | Select the GDN decode kernel independently of prefill and KDA (shared upstream name). |
| `VLLM_SAIL_QSA_KERNEL` | `auto` | `auto`, `cuda`, `triton` | `VLLM_PPU_QSA_KERNEL` | Select the Qwen4Exp QSA sparse-attention kernel (`cuda` selects FA3's QSA path when supported). |
| `VLLM_SAIL_FUSED_RMSNORM_QUANT` | `0` | `0`, `1` | `VLLM_PPU_FUSED_RMSNORM_QUANT` | Enable supported fused RMSNorm and quantization paths. |
| `VLLM_SAIL_USE_OPT_TOKEN_GROUP_QUANT` | `0` | `0`, `1` | `VLLM_PPU_USE_OPT_TOKEN_GROUP_QUANT` | Enable the optimized token-group quantization path. |
| `VLLM_SAIL_USE_TRITON_INT8_QUANT` | `1` | `0`, `1` | `VLLM_PPU_USE_TRITON_INT8_QUANT` | Use Triton dynamic per-token INT8 activation quantization. |
| `VLLM_DEEPEPLL_RECV_HOOK` | `1` | `0`, `1` | — | Use DeepEP low-latency deferred receive hook; `0` selects the event-based fallback (shared upstream name). |

## DeepSeek V4.1

| Variable | Default | Values | Aliases | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `VLLM_SAIL_MEGA_MOE_MMA_TYPE` | `fp8xfp4` | `fp4xfp4`, `fp8xfp4`, `bf16xfp4` | `VLLM_PPU_MEGA_MOE_MMA_TYPE` | Activation precision for DeepGEMM MegaMoE MXFP4 routed experts (`fp4xfp4`=W4A4, `fp8xfp4`=W4A8, `bf16xfp4`=W4A16). |
| `VLLM_SAIL_DISABLE_MEGA_MHC` | `0` | `0`, `1` | `VLLM_PPU_DISABLE_MEGA_MHC`, `SAIL_DISABLE_MEGA_MHC` | Disable the PPU DeepGEMM Mega mHC kernel on Zhenwu M890 and fall back to the upstream TileLang mHC path. |
| `VLLM_SAIL_FUSED_NORM_ROPE_ATTN` | `0` | `0`, `1` | `VLLM_PPU_FUSED_NORM_ROPE_ATTN` | Opt into the PPU fused norm-rope sparse-attention path; requires `VLLM_SAIL_PPU_KV_MXFP8=1`, a compatible `flash_mla` wheel, and supported V4.1 topology. |
| `VLLM_SAIL_PPU_KV_MXFP8` | `0` | `0`, `1` | `VLLM_PPU_PPU_KV_MXFP8` | Select the 528-byte V4.1 MXFP8 KV record required by the fused decode kernel instead of the default 584-byte V4 record (read once per process). |
| `VLLM_SAIL_PPU_KV_NVFP4` | `0` | `0`, `1` | `VLLM_PPU_PPU_KV_NVFP4` | Opt into a 288-byte NVFP4 record for the compressed KV cache while keeping 528-byte MXFP8 for the sliding-window cache; requires `VLLM_SAIL_FUSED_NORM_ROPE_ATTN=1`, `VLLM_SAIL_PPU_KV_MXFP8=1`, Zhenwu M890 (capability 8.9), and `sliding_window % 8 == 0` (lossy). |
| `VLLM_SAIL_FUSED_ATTN_PER_TOKEN_SCALE` | `0` | `0`, `1` | `VLLM_PPU_FUSED_ATTN_PER_TOKEN_SCALE` | Use exact per-token FP32 output scales per WV group instead of packed per-32 UE8M0 scales in fused V4.1 attention; requires Zhenwu M890 (capability 8.9) and a compatible `flash_mla` wheel. |

## Online quantization and compatibility

| Variable | Default | Values | Aliases | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `VLLM_SAIL_FP8_LOAD_POLICY` | Unset (automatic) | `native`, `bf16`, `int8` | `VLLM_PPU_FP8_LOAD_POLICY` | Default loading-time FP8 conversion policy when no explicit `--quantization` argument is supplied. |
| `VLLM_SAIL_ENABLE_FP8_TO_INT8` | `0` | `0`, `1` | `VLLM_PPU_ENABLE_FP8_TO_INT8` | Legacy loading-time FP8 switch used when `VLLM_SAIL_FP8_LOAD_POLICY` is unset (`1`=INT8, `0`=BF16 when explicitly set). |
| `VLLM_SAIL_DISABLE_MOE_WNA16_CUDA` | `0` | `0`, `1` | `VLLM_PPU_DISABLE_MOE_WNA16_CUDA` | Disable the native WNA16 MoE path; takes precedence over `VLLM_SAIL_FORCE_MOE_WNA16_CUDA`. |
| `VLLM_SAIL_FORCE_MOE_WNA16_CUDA` | `0` | `0`, `1` | `VLLM_PPU_FORCE_MOE_WNA16_CUDA` | Request the native WNA16 MoE path; raises if the kernel is unavailable. |
| `VLLM_SAIL_ENABLE_MOE_MARLIN` | `0` | `0`, `1` | `VLLM_PPU_ENABLE_MOE_MARLIN` | Legacy selection gate; does not enable excluded native Marlin kernels. |
| `VLLM_SAIL_FUSED_GDN_DECODE` | `1` | `0`, `1` | `VLLM_PPU_FUSED_GDN_DECODE` | Legacy getter; GDN decode dispatch now uses `VLLM_GDN_DECODE_KERNEL` and `VLLM_SAIL_USE_PLA`. |
